data.name: fake-news-detection-using-bert-and-capsule-network
data.description: AI-powered Fake News Detection system using BERT and Capsule Networks for real-time news verification. The project classifies news articles and social media content as Real , Fake and Misleading, achieving 89.5% accuracy. Built with Python, PyTorch, Transformers, and FastAPI.

data.name: fastapi-product-catalog-api
data.description: A RESTful Product Catalog API built with FastAPI featuring product search, filtering, sorting, pagination, UUID-based retrieval, and product creation using JSON data storage.
